Question: Salam, I want to know about Istekhara.I am in love with a boy from last 2 yrs.we Both are five times Namazi,never miss any namaz,anywhere,anytime..Alhamdolillah, I did Istekhara that whether I will be married to him or not.In the dream I saw Him,alongwith me..standing together, we were attending some marriage function and I saw one Boy & Girl getting married,sitting on chair and I was thinking that we have came to attend someOne's marriage. Could you please help me in knowing exact Interpretation of this Dream? Answer ID: 20855 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 491/367/D=1431) Do not feel contented with one time istikharah, rather do it some more time, if after that the inclination or tendency of your heart is same, inform your parents. If they adopt appropriate step it is better, taking step from on your own is not good. ما خاب من استخار و ما ندم من استستار Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
